sentences.en: The date of the examination clashed with my sister's wedding.
sentences.zh: 考试日期和我妹妹的婚礼冲突了。

sentences.en: Violent clashes broke out between the protesters and the police.
sentences.zh: 抗议者和警察之间爆发了激烈的冲突。

sentences.en: The two strongest teams will clash with each other this weekend.
sentences.zh: 这两支最强的队伍这个周末将要交锋。
